BrochureContent.Content:
REA Stokes Quirke are delighted to present this substantial 7-bedroom detached bungalow, occupying a superb elevated site in Ardfinnan and enjoying breath taking panoramic views of the surrounding village, overlooking the river and castle to the front. Set on a generous, well-maintained site, this impressive residence offers exceptional space and flexibility, making it an ideal family home or suitable for those seeking multi-generational living.
Internally, the property extends to spacious and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, comprising seven bedrooms, two bright and comfortable living rooms, two fully fitted kitchens and a separate dining room, providing excellent versatility for modern family life and entertaining. The home is further enhanced by oil-fired central heating and offers an abundance of living space to suit a variety of needs.
Outside, the property is surrounded by extensive gardens with large patio areas, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining while taking in the spectacular countryside views. Three detached garages provide excellent storage, workshop or hobby space, while the expansive driveway offers ample off-street parking for numerous vehicles.
Enjoying a peaceful yet convenient location in Ardfinnan village and its local amenities, this outstanding home combines generous accommodation, exceptional outdoor space and a truly picturesque setting. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this fine property has to offer.
